about: Creation bench: twenty original briefs (mechanical, creative, organic, assemblies; no character or brand) run through Form Studio's MCP tools by an agent, skeleton first, one feature per call (scripts/creation_bench.py). 'features' are groups of words a good answer's feature ids or labels contain (scored by tests/design_bench/bench.py); 'complex' is whether the staged workflow should trigger. The scripted stub agent (tests/fixtures/scripted_agent.py) has one script per id.

briefs.brief: A clamping shaft coupler from a 5 mm motor shaft to an 8 mm leadscrew.
A pillow block for a 608 bearing with two slotted mounting holes and ribs.
A quick-release tube clamp with a cam lever for a 25.4 mm bar.
A 5:1 planetary gearbox stage with a flanged ring housing and a carrier.
A 35 mm DIN-rail clip with a fixed hook and a sprung latch.
A cable drag-chain link that snaps to the next one.
A vase with spiral ribs and a rolled lip.
A table lamp with a lofted, twisted shade on a weighted base.
A knurled control knob for a 6 mm D-shaft with a pointer.
A planter with a hexagonal relief texture on its wall, drain holes and a drip saucer.
A pebble-shaped earbud case with a hinged lid and two earbud pockets.
An original full-face hero helmet in separate parts: a shell, a magnetic faceplate and two lenses, with a hex panel texture.
An open-face scooter helmet shell with a sun peak and vents.
An ergonomic computer mouse shell with a thumb rest and textured sides.
An ergonomic screwdriver handle with a textured grip and a hex bit socket.
A curved creature horn with growth rings and a mounting base.
An electronics enclosure with a screwed lid, heat-set insert bosses, a seal lip and vent slots.
A box for two AA cells with a sliding lid that clicks shut.
A two-part desk organizer held together by 8x3 mm magnets.
A ratchet wrench with a pawl and a quarter-inch square drive.
